newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SINGAPORE BUNKERS END WEEK ON A SOFTER NOTE.
newsitem.headline: SINGAPORE BUNKERS END WEEK ON A SOFTER NOTE.

text.p: Singapore bunker prices ended the week on a softer note after chalking up rises four days in row on tight supplies, traders said.
They said bunker supplies were offered at about $2.00 less than Thursday with 380-cst sellers at $104/$106 per tonne and 180-cst offered at around $107-109.
"There is some aggressive selling out there as some people think the market is going to go down and are securing sales for the next two weeks," one major said.
MDO and gas oil were indicated around $170 and $180 per tonne, respectively. -- Singapore Newsroom (65-870 3093)
